Fruit

Cantaloupe

About This Entry

Cantaloupe delivers musky orange flesh and floral sweetness in fruit platters and prosciutto wraps — its aromatic melon depth pairs with Prosciutto di Parma, Moscato, and off-dry sparkling wine.
